name: cors-origin-input
title: CORS Origin Input
description: Catches * with credentials, null, trailing slashes or paths, missing schemes, default ports and http or localhost in production, with one-tap fixes and a tester that names the near miss blocking an origin.

meta.summary: Checks a CORS allow-list for origins that never match or open the API to every site, and tests an origin against it.
meta.server: Enforce CORS in the server or gateway with exact origin matching, and authenticate API requests independently of CORS.
catches: * combined with credentials, and the null origin
Trailing slashes or paths, which never match an Origin header
Missing scheme and explicit default ports
http:// or localhost origins in production
Near misses when testing an origin against the list
limits: Checks the list text; your server's CORS middleware may normalise or match differently
CORS controls browsers only; it is not access control for the API
a11y: Labelled add field; origins are a labelled list with remove buttons named per origin
aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" issues region
Severity is stated in text (", error" / ", warning"), not just colour
Enter adds an origin; focus moves sensibly after removals and fixes
